otherFindings.summary: Action Text content-attachment representation changes, so rich-text rendering and plain-text export can differ; the report also flags the vendored Trix 1.3.5 asset mismatch.
Active Storage filename sanitization now replaces characters such as ?, * and " with hyphens in displayed and downloaded filenames.
The resolved json 3.1.0 rejects duplicate keys and comments, so some citation-provider responses could be marked as failed.
Local signing-key selection moves from tmp/development_secret.txt to tmp/local_secret.txt, which can invalidate local sessions and signed attachment references.
The built-in Sidekiq Active Job adapter is deprecated for removal in Rails 8.2, and moving to Sidekiq 7.3.3 or later is a separate decision.

otherFindings.summary: Action Text HTML content attachment representation changes and the Trix 1.3.5 vendored script vs gem-provided action_text-trix CSS mismatch (high).
Active Storage filename sanitization now turns characters like ?, *, " into hyphens in displayed/downloaded attachment names (high).
Resolved json 3.1.0 rejects duplicate keys/comments, so provider responses previously accepted may fail citation enrichment (high).
Local development/test secret key selection moves from tmp/development_secret.txt to tmp/local_secret.txt, invalidating sessions and signed attachment references (high).
Built-in Sidekiq Active Job adapter is deprecated for removal in Rails 8.2, requiring a Sidekiq ≥7.3.3 decision (medium).
